question.worked_solution:
First, we convert the given probability into a cumulative probability:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X<2.5)=0.7881\,⇒\,P(X\le 2.5)=0.7881\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we transform to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le 2.5) & =0.7881 \\ P(Z\le \frac{2.5-\mu }{4}) & =0.7881 \\ Φ(\frac{2.5-\mu }{4}) & =0.7881 \\ \frac{2.5-\mu }{4} & ={Φ}^{-1}(0.7881)\end{aligned}
$$

According to the table, we have

$$
Φ(0.80)=0.7881\,⇒\,{Φ}^{-1}(0.7881)=0.80.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{2.5-\mu }{4} & =0.80 \\ 2.5-\mu  & =3.2 \\ \mu  & =-0.7.\end{aligned}
$$
